title: Configure Matrix
description: Configure the Synapse homeserver, its web apps and bridges

server_name.description: Matrix server name, the part after ':' in user IDs. Empty uses host. Cannot be changed after the first configuration.

host.description: Host name of the homeserver (client and federation API), like 'matrix.example.org'

lets_encrypt.description: Request Let's Encrypt certificates for all host names

user_domain.description: NS8 user domain whose users log in with their password; empty allows local accounts only

wellknown_on_server_name.description: Route https://<server_name>/.well-known/matrix to Synapse (only if server_name differs from host)

element_host.description: Host name for Element Web; empty disables it

cinny_host.description: Host name for Cinny; empty disables it

ketesa_host.description: Host name for the Ketesa admin UI; empty disables it

mail_from.description: Sender address of notification mails; empty uses noreply@<server_name>

telegram_api_id.description: Telegram API ID from my.telegram.org (required for the Telegram bridge)

telegram_api_hash.description: Telegram API hash; empty keeps the stored one

turn.description: Run the coturn TURN server (UDP) for calls; Synapse and LiveKit use it

element_call.description: Element Call (MatrixRTC): LiveKit SFU and JWT service below the homeserver host, embedded Element Call in Element Web

calls_public_ip.description: Public IP address of the node for TURN and LiveKit media; empty: coturn uses the node addresses, LiveKit asks a STUN server
